messages:
maria: Heads up — staging -> prod push starts in 10m. will run 2% canary, then 20% if healthy. tagging the lifeboat runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lifeboat-evacuation-v2 :boat:

deploy-bot: [deploy] release=v3.12.0 started · canary=2% · initiator=maria · changelist=GH:3421

jamal: Quick Q — where's the minimal rollback path? want the exact command in case we need to abort fast.

maria: Jamal — link above has the concise checklist. TL;DR:
- immediate criteria: 5m error rate > 1% OR p95 latency +30% over baseline for 5m
- soft criteria: increased tail latency, customer-facing errors in /v1/generate
- actions: 1) abort canary 2) pin traffic to previous commit 3) run hotfix branch if needed

maria: rollback commands (copy/paste):
```
# abort current deploy and pin previous stable
./infra/deployctl abort --release v3.12.0 --reason "canary fail"
./infra/deployctl pin --service text-gen --version v3.11.9
# if automated pin fails, manual unroute: /ops/route unroute --from canary --to stable
```

alan: +1 on keeping the pin step explicit. also note DB feature-flag toggle for streaming-parser must be off prior to rolling back (see runbook step 4).

jen (sre): Metrics to watch in Datadog:
- dd.metrics.requests.error_rate (1m, 5m)
- dd.apm.service.text-gen.p95 latency
- dd.service.cache.hit_ratio (drop indicates warm-up issues)
If error_rate > 1% for 5m -> abort. If p95 > 350ms for 5m -> abort.

jamal: Got it. Who's owning the unpin if deploy-bot doesn't succeed?

maria: I'll be primary. Alan fallback. Jen watches infra alarms and will trigger abort if thresholds hit. Jamal you coordinate release notes and postmortem if we hit abort.

deploy-bot: [status] canary(2%) healthy · observed error_rate=0.12% · p95=210ms · duration=6m

alan: If abort, quick escalation path is: pager to #eng-oncall -> call/zoom -> runbook step 6 manual DB-toggle. Keep comms on this thread.

maria: moving to 20% in 2m unless we see >0.5% error rate tick.

deploy-bot: [progress] promoted canary -> 20% · release=v3.12.0 · started=4790012347

jamal: Noting release note snippet: "feature X can improve latency for short prompts; rolling out gradually. Rolling back will revert parser flag and pin to v3.11.9." I'll post in #release-notes once 20% clear.

jen (sre): watching — set alert to notify this thread if error_rate crosses 0.8% for 3m.

maria: thanks. if anyone sees a spike, call out with single line: "abort: reason" so deploy-bot picks it up.

alan: ack.

deploy-bot: [final] 20% stable at +8m · metrics nominal · will continue rollout per schedule. remember runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lifeboat-evacuation-v2

maria: thanks team — keeping thread for post-deploy notes. will file a short runbook update after the window to capture the DB toggle nuance. :white_check_mark:
